items.heading: That Seasonal Swing Is Rarely
items.text: That seasonal swing is rarely treated as a planning problem worth solving directly - it is just accepted as "how Goa works," even when it is quietly limiting how fast you can move toward earlier financial freedom.

items.heading: The Stronger Question Is What
items.text: The stronger question is what specific skill portfolio would let you carry stronger, steadier income across the full year, not just the high season.
